generalInfo.value:
1. Total 8329.6 m / 138 rolls - 104.12% of the booking quantity were finished and packed.
2. Approval sample without client's signature was provided by factory during inspection.
3. No calibration label was found on fabric weight scale and meter reader.
4. Only factory's pen marked label was found on fabric rolls, the supplier declared they would paste correct roll labels before shipment.
5. No round color sticker was found on each dye lot.
6. Fabric total width (150cm) and fabric weight (266.67gsm) specifications were provided by factory on site.
7. No Roll label on all rolls during inspection, the supplier declared they would paste correct roll labels before shipment

alsoWorthNoting.description: The factory provided an approval sample during inspection, but it lacked the client's signature.

recommendedActions.actionContent: A sealed and dated approval sample that includes production dates is essential. This practice ensures easy identification on-site by both our inspectors and the factory, minimizing any confusion regarding the requirements to be followed.

alsoWorthNoting.description: No calibration labels were present on the fabric weight scale or meter reader.

recommendedActions.actionContent: Ensure that a detailed log is maintained for each tool, documenting its calibration history, next due date, and any issues encountered. Using uncalibrated tools can lead to inaccurate measurements.

alsoWorthNoting.description: A total of 8,329.6 meters across 138 rolls, representing 104.12% of the booked quantity, were finished and packed.
The factory provided fabric specifications on site: total width of 150 cm and weight of 266.67 gsm.

nonConformities.description: Fabric rolls had only handwritten marks; the supplier stated they would attach correct roll labels before shipment.

testPhotos.comment: Fabric rolls had only handwritten marks; the supplier stated they would attach correct roll labels before shipment.

recommendedActions.actionContent: Implement a formal procedure to verify label information with the factory before finalizing orders with label suppliers or internal production teams.
